long_description:
Ad Army is an AI creative tool for brands that need a constant supply of ad creative.

You build your brand's world once — characters, products, locations — each with locked descriptors and reference images. Then you generate against it: @-mention an entity in a prompt and its references are pulled into the model call, so the same product, the same face and the same location hold across images, video, and dozens of variants. Save any chain of steps as a recipe and replay it on the next campaign.

We're model-agnostic by design — video, image, text and audio providers sit behind one interface, and new models land as they ship. For a full narrative spot, the same world scripts, storyboards, animates, voices, captions and exports multi-scene ads in every aspect ratio.
name: Ad Army
one_liner: Generate, iterate, and ship AI ad creatives faster
